PS1:clock-tower-2.d: Clock Tower, known in Japan as Clock Tower 2, is a point-and-click survival horror video game developed by Human Entertainment and released for the PlayStation in 1996. It is the second game in the Clock Tower series after the original Clock Tower, which was released exclusively in Japan for the Super Famicom one year prior. The story takes place in Norway and follows a variety of characters as they attempt to survive the return of Scissorman and uncover the mystery of his seemingly immortal state. The scenarios encountered and endings vary widely based upon the player's actions.

Switch:lost-child.d: The Lost Child is a 2017 role-playing videogame developed by Crim for the PlayStation 4, PlayStation Vita and Nintendo Switch. The game was removed from all digital platforms in European, American, Asian and Oceania regions on 18 June 2023 and can no longer be purchased. This was due to Dragami Games taking over the publishing rights.

DC:space-channel-5.d: Space Channel 5 is a 1999 music video game developed and published by Sega for the Dreamcast. It was later ported to the PlayStation 2 and Game Boy Advance. The game was conceived by Tetsuya Mizuguchi, who was told to create something aimed at a female audience.
